objective: Preallocate DROP INDEX single-column cleanup prefixes from table and column name lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate DROP INDEX prefixes
tasks.result: DROP INDEX single-column cleanup now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for index:<table>:<column>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for index:<table>:<column>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in DROP INDEX single-column index-entry cleanup prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, scan_prefix inputs, deleted index entries, schema index flags, and SQL index behavior are unchanged.
